items.title: Critical RCE Vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server
items.summary: A newly discovered remote code execution vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server could allow attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected systems. Developers and system administrators should prioritize patching their installations to mitigate potential risks.

items.title: Gemini Decisions API Launch
items.summary: Google has launched the Gemini Decisions API, enabling developers to integrate advanced decision-making capabilities into their applications. This API aims to enhance AI-driven solutions across various domains, making it easier for engineers to implement intelligent features.

items.title: United Airlines Bans AI Agents from Booking Flights
items.summary: In a significant move, United Airlines has prohibited AI agents from booking flights on behalf of travelers, citing concerns over customer service and reliability. This decision highlights the ongoing debate about the role of AI in customer-facing applications.

items.title: AWS Emulator Now Available on GitHub
items.summary: AWS has released an emulator on GitHub that allows developers to simulate AWS services locally. This tool is expected to streamline development workflows and reduce costs associated with cloud service usage during the development phase.

items.title: Why Writing Correct Software Is Hard
items.summary: A new article explores the complexities involved in writing correct software, discussing the inherent challenges of software correctness and the implications for developers. Understanding these challenges is crucial for engineers aiming to improve software reliability.
